info.title: Tandem API
info.description: Authentication, administration, instance integrations and the chat skeleton. Cookie-authenticated; state-changing calls need the X-CSRF-Token header returned by GET /api/auth/me.

get.summary: The version, licence and source location of this running copy.
Query the audit log, newest first.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Only this event type, for example `auth.sign_in.failure`.

parameters.name: after_time
parameters.description: Page cursor: the `next_after_time` of the previous page.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Page cursor: the `next_after_id` of the previous page.

put.summary: Save or replace the GitHub token. The token is never returned.

delete.summary: Remove the GitHub token; the connector is then off.

post.summary: Test the GitHub token: the account, its expiry and the repositories it reaches.

409.description: A test is already running; the body carries its run_id

post.summary: Invite someone. Nothing is emailed; the link is returned once.

get.summary: The default models, with where each comes from and any warnings.

put.summary: Choose the default models. A model with warnings is allowed; the warnings come back.

get.summary: List model providers with their models and last test.

post.summary: Add a provider.

put.summary: Change a provider. An empty `api_key` keeps the saved key; `remove_api_key` deletes it.

delete.summary: Remove a provider, its models and key, clearing the defaults that used them.

get.summary: What removing a provider would do, for the confirmation.

post.summary: Test a provider and each of its models. Runs in the background: poll the run.

409.description: A test is already running; the body carries its run_id

post.summary: Check whether the container runtime answers, without starting anything.

409.description: A check is already running; the body carries its run_id

get.summary: The sandbox policy with the factory values, allowed ranges and the tool registry.

put.summary: Save the sandbox policy. Choosing the container tier needs a runtime that answers right now.

get.summary: All search providers and which one is active.

put.summary: Turn one search provider on (the others go off), or search off with no `kind`.
Save one search provider's settings; the overview comes back.

post.summary: Test one search provider with a small query.

409.description: A test is already running; the body carries its run_id

get.summary: A test run, for the screen that polls it.

post.summary: Deactivate a user and end their sign-ins.
Reactivate a user.
Issue a one-time password-reset link for a user.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their scope and the CSRF token.

post.summary: Confirm enrolment with a code; returns the recovery codes once.
Turn MFA off (members only).
Begin MFA enrolment: returns the secret to show once.
Replace the recovery codes; returns the new set once.
Change the signed-in user's password.
Sign in with email, password and, when enrolled, a second factor.
End the current sign-in.

get.summary: The caller's chat sessions, newest first.

post.summary: Start a chat session.

get.summary: The messages of one of the caller's sessions, oldest first.

post.summary: Post a message; the agent's reply arrives over the event feed.
Accept an invitation: creates the account and signs in.
Check an invitation link.
Finish a password reset.
Check a password-reset link.

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is still open.

post.summary: Create the first admin and sign in with an enrolment-only scope.

AboutDto.description: The legal notices and provenance of this running copy.

license.description: The licence, as an SPDX identifier.

license_url.description: Where to read the licence text.

source_url.description: Where the Corresponding Source of this running version is (AGPL section 13).

upstream_url.description: The original project, credited as "Based on Tandem".

ActivationDto.description: The result of turning search on or off.

untested.description: The provider has never passed a test.

ActiveSearchRequest.description: Which search provider to turn on; leave out to turn search off.

mfa_enrolled.description: Whether the user has confirmed MFA.

AdminUserDto.description: A user in the admin list, with their MFA state.

actor_label.description: The actor's name at the time.

details.description: Extra facts, with secrets already removed.

AuditPageDto.description: A page of audit entries, newest first.

next_after_time.description: Pass these two values back as `after_time` and `after_id` for the next page.

author.description: The user ID or the agent's name.

in_reply_to.description: The message this answers, for agent replies.

ConnectorDto.description: The GitHub connector. The token is never included.

account_login.description: The account the token belongs to, after a successful test.

active_test_id.description: A test queued or running now.

token_expires_at.description: When the token expires, when GitHub says.

DefaultChoiceDto.description: One default model and where it comes from.

DefaultsDto.description: The two default models. A default with `warnings` is allowed but flagged.

oneOf.description: The model for thread and task agents.

DefaultsRequest.description: The picks, by model ID; leave one out to unset it.

agents_model_id.description: The model for thread and task agents.

code.description: A current authenticator or recovery code.

EnrolmentResponse.description: The MFA secret to show once.

otpauth_uri.description: The `otpauth://` URI for a QR code.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error answer.

message.description: A plain-words message safe to show to the user.

run_id.description: The run already in progress, for `already_running`.

FailureDto.description: Why a run failed as a whole.

FieldProblem.description: One field problem in a validation answer.

field.description: The field as the client knows it.

InvitationDto.description: An invitation in the admin list.

InvitationInfoDto.description: What an invitation link is for.

InviteCreatedDto.description: A new invitation with its one-time link.

link.description: The link to give to the invitee; shown once.

cpu_millicores.description: CPU in millicores (enforced by the container runner only).

max_file_bytes.description: Largest single file a run may write.

max_files_written.description: Files a run may create or change.

memory_mebibytes.description: Memory in MiB (enforced by the container runner only).

MeResponse.description: The signed-in user, their scope and the CSRF token for state-changing calls.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

ModelDto.description: A model with what a test found and what an admin declared.

disagrees_with_detection.description: A declared value disagrees with what a test found.

name.description: The name the provider's API expects.

tool_calling.description: Tool calling as used: declared if declared, otherwise detected.

warnings.description: Why this model may not suit a job; empty when it does.

declared_context_tokens.description: Declare the context length in tokens.

id.description: The existing model this edits; leave out for a new one.

name.description: The name the provider's API expects.

PolicyRequest.description: The policy as entered. The version and scope are not accepted.

PolicyViewDto.description: The policy with what the editor needs: factory values, ranges and the tool registry.

factory.description: The factory default, for "Reset to default".

ProbeDetailsDto.description: Facts a probe learned. Never secrets and never text from the remote server.

account_login.description: The GitHub account the token belongs to.

context_tokens.description: A model's context length in tokens.

repositories.description: Up to 100 repositories the token can reach.

repository_total.description: How many repositories the token can reach.

token_expires_at.description: When the GitHub token expires, if GitHub says.

message.description: A fixed, safe sentence for the status.

ProviderDto.description: A provider. The key is never included.

active_test_id.description: A test queued or running now.

api_key_saved.description: Whether an API key is saved.

api_key_saved_at.description: When the key was last saved.

api_key.description: A new API key. Absent or empty keeps the saved one.

RangeDto.description: An allowed range for one limit.

cleared_defaults.description: Defaults that are or will be cleared: `orchestrator` and/or `agents`.

model_count.description: How many models go with it.

ResetInfoDto.description: Whose password a reset link is for.

link.description: The link to give to the user.

reset_mfa.description: Also remove the user's MFA enrolment.

SearchKindDto.description: One search provider's settings and test state. The key is never included.

active_test_id.description: A test queued or running now.

api_key_saved.description: Whether an API key is saved.

api_key_saved_at.description: When the key was last saved.

needs_key.description: An API key is needed (Brave, Tavily).

needs_url.description: The admin supplies the base URL (SearXNG).

api_key.description: A new API key. Absent or empty keeps the saved one.

base_url.description: SearXNG's base URL; empty uses the bundled service.

SecondFactorDto.description: A second factor submitted with sign-in.

absolute_duration_seconds.description: Sign out after this many seconds in total.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Sign out after this many idle seconds.

online_breach_check.description: Also check passwords against the online breach service.

SessionStarted.description: A session started by setup or invitation acceptance.

SetupStatus.description: Whether first-run setup is still open.

available.description: True until the first admin exists.

oneOf.description: Required when the account has MFA.

SignInResponse.description: The result of a sign-in step.

TestRunDto.description: A test run: queued, running or finished, with the results so far.

oneOf.description: Set when the run itself could not complete.

results.description: Results so far, in arrival order.

TokenRequest.description: A link token from an invitation or reset link.

can_be_enabled.description: `false` for `command_run`, which is listed but never enabled.

UserDto.description: A user as the client sees them.

last_sign_in_at.description: The last successful sign-in, if any.

WarningDto.description: Something wrong with a model for a job.

have.description: The context a model has, for `context_too_small`.

need.description: The context a job needs, for `context_too_small`.
